sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.32202 Of 2023
Order:

The writ petition is filed seeking following relief:
"......to issue an order, Writ or direction more particularly in the nature of the Writ of Mandamus declaring/quash proclamation notice dated 24.01.2023 bearing No.65/PD- Cell/CYB?2021-23 issued by respondent No.2 requiring the appearance of the accused issued under Section 82 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 read with Section 7 of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot - Leggers,
Dacoits, Drug - Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders Land - Grabbers,
Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 as illegal, arbitrary and violation of Article 14, 19, 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India, 1950"
2.

entities.text:
Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot - Leggers,
Dacoits, Drug - Offenders, Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case of the petitioner is that he is engaged in the business of trading of garments in the State of Maharashtra for the past 10 years.

It is further case of the petitioner that on 24.01.2023 a proclamation notice under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. read with Section 7 of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot - CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 Leggers, Dacoits, Drug - Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders Land - Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders,
Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") was issued against the petitioner wherein it is alleged that a detention order was passed against him on 02.06.2021 declaring him as "Fake Document offender".

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot - CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 Leggers, Dacoits, Drug - Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders Land - Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders,
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further case of the petitioner that the respondents herein have not served a copy of the detention order to enable him to question the same.

It is further case of the petitioner that he made an application under the Right to Information Act, 2005 to furnish the information relating to detention order No.65/PD-Cell/CYB/2021-23 of the Act and also requested to provide detailed information about the grounds of detention for issuance of the Preventive Detention Order.

3. Sri A.Venkatesh, learned Senior Counsel representing the learned counsel for the petitioner vehemently contended that even CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 after making an application vide Chandrakanth Siddarth Kamble vs The State Of Telangana on 22 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109965632/
1 C.No.A6/94/RTI/Cyb/2023, dated 20.04.2023 requesting to serve copy of the detention order to enable the petitioner to question the same in terms of the Act, the respondents have not furnished the copy of the same, except affixing proclamation notice issued in Proceedings No.65/PD- Cell/CYB/2021-23 dated 24.01.2023.

entities.text: Chandrakanth Siddarth Kamble vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel further contended that the respondents have not followed the procedure as contemplated under the Act before initiating the proceedings against the petitioner under the Act which is violative of Articles 14, 19, 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India.

4. Heard the submissions of learned Government Pleader for Home Department appearing for the respondents.
5.

In view of the aforesaid submissions, this Court without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, deems it appropriate to dispose of the Writ Petition granting liberty to the petitioner to approach the 2nd respondent for receiving the copy of the Preventive Detention Order within a period of two (02) weeks from today.
Further, the impugned notice issued vide Proceedings No.65/PD-Cell/CYB/2021-23 dated 24.01.2023 is hereby suspended CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 for a period of two (02) weeks.

It is made clear that in the event of the petitioner approaches the 2nd respondent to receive the copy of the Preventive Detention Order, the 2nd respondent shall not arrest the petitioner for a period of one week, subject to the petitioner giving an undertaking that he will surrender himself immediately after expiry of one week.

It is also made clear that if the petitioner does not approach respondent No.2 to receive the Preventive Detention Order within the aforesaid period of two weeks, the respondent authorities are at liberty to proceed further against the petitioner, in accordance with law.
6. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

Note:
C.C. today b/o.
